evals.name: Review and publish when the request explicitly authorizes it
evals.prompt: Review and publish the current branch as a PR. Build completed MID-123 (model hydration fix). Branch is mid-123-model-hydration. Tests pass and typecheck passes. The ticket was updated to authorize strict parsing instead of graceful degradation. No existing PR exists.
evals.expected_output: The agent reviews against the updated ticket, produces a decision, then performs the explicitly authorized commit, push, and PR creation with evidence-aware context.
assertions: Commits changes or confirms they are committed
Discovers no existing PR for the branch
Raises a new PR
PR description includes the deliberate drift from Build
PR description includes validation evidence
Produces a review decision

evals.name: Review and update an existing PR when explicitly requested
evals.prompt: Review the current branch for MID-456 and update its existing PR. PR #789 is open for this branch with unresolved review comments. New commits address two of the three comments.
evals.expected_output: The agent discovers the existing PR, updates it with the new commits rather than creating a duplicate, resolves the addressed comments, and reviews the remaining open comment.
assertions: Discovers the existing PR #789
Updates the existing PR instead of creating a new one
Addresses the resolved review comments
Identifies the remaining unresolved comment

evals.name: Classify review findings and route to Build
evals.prompt: Review PR #456 for MID-123. The PR has three comments: (1) 'Add a comment explaining the strict parsing rationale' — valid, (2) 'Rename this variable' — trivial style preference, (3) 'This might break the mobile app's error handling' — needs product decision about whether mobile can handle strict errors.
evals.expected_output: The agent classifies each comment: (1) valid and actionable — route to Build, (2) trivial — note but low priority, (3) needs product decision — escalate. Routes actionable fixes to the smallest Build loop.
assertions: Classifies each review comment individually
Routes the actionable fix to Build
Escalates the product-sensitive comment
Does not silently resolve the disputed comment

evals.name: Accept focused unit evidence for isolated logic
evals.prompt: Review a pure currency-formatting function with no I/O, UI, callbacks, or cross-layer behavior. Focused unit tests cover its inputs, rounding boundaries, and errors; no integration, UI, or end-to-end test was added.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the focused unit tests as sufficient evidence for this isolated behavior and does not demand a broader harness without a boundary to exercise.
assertions: Recognizes the behavior as isolated logic
Accepts focused unit tests as sufficient evidence
Does not require an integration, UI, or end-to-end test without a boundary

evals.name: Require system-level evidence for cross-layer behavior
evals.prompt: Review a profile-save change that crosses form validation, the API, and persistence. Unit tests with mocked API and database dependencies pass, but the repository's existing Playwright end-to-end save scenario was not run.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats isolated unit tests as insufficient evidence for the cross-layer behavior and blocks approval until the existing end-to-end harness validates the real save journey.
assertions: Recognizes that the change crosses multiple layers
Does not treat mocked unit tests as sufficient behavior evidence
Requires the existing end-to-end harness
Returns blocked or request-changes rather than approve
